sources.name: 03_engineering_workflow_sdlc_configuration_management_v2.md
sources.applicability: Explicit intent, risk-proportionate assurance and canonical configuration authority; small coherent commits with immutable revision identity. Source tests and CI remain evidence rather than release authorization. Bind artifact, configuration and schema before promotion; state-compatible recovery, independent review and actual operating verification remain separate.

sources.name: 01_requirements_specification_domain_engineering_master_playbook_v2.2.md
sources.applicability: Separate intended outcomes, requirements, constraints, assumptions and acceptance evidence. Preserve all requested invariants and native authority; specify bounded failure, privacy, time and concurrency behavior. Risk-proportionate traceability, four distinct verification/validation questions, and no invented completeness or causal qualification.

sources.name: 02_software_architecture_system_design_v2.1_research_audited_golden_master.md
sources.applicability: Prefer native modular boundaries and PostgreSQL authority; explicit write owners, derived-state reconciliation, tenancy and privacy lifecycle; invariant-driven consistency, bounded retries/queues and observable recovery. Architecture descriptions and reference patterns do not establish implementation or operating qualification.

sources.name: 04_software_construction_code_quality_v2.md
sources.applicability: Coherent native implementations, explicit state and mutation authority, runtime boundary validation and failure semantics, justified dependencies, and risk-relevant verification; no arbitrary size thresholds or claims of independent review from author tests.

sources.name: 06_security_engineering_v2_golden_master.md
sources.applicability: Reuse current native authorization at every route, source and effect; structural tenant and replay controls; distinguish authorship tests from independent assurance; bounded untrusted attributes; retain explicit recovery and governance gaps. Framework and publication-status claims require current primary-source verification before reliance.

sources.name: 05_verification_validation_testing_quality_engineering_v2.md
sources.applicability: Claim-driven, risk-proportionate assurance with explicit independent oracles and real boundary semantics. Negative, concurrent, partial-failure, migration and restore reconciliation evidence where material. Tests, coverage, scanners and local fixtures do not certify release, accessibility, provider or hosted behavior; bind evidence to source, configuration and artifact identity.

sources.name: 08_reliability_resilience_observability_sre_v2_golden_master.md
sources.applicability: Reliability follows critical user outcomes and protected integrity, privacy and authorization invariants. Distinguish healthy from unobserved telemetry, partial or unknown outcomes, and controlled degraded states; bound overload and retry amplification. Backups, replication, copied-database tests and DR documents are different evidence from executed archive restoration and hosted critical-flow recovery. Require state-compatible recovery, actual operating ownership, meaningful stop conditions and verified incident actions; use the least complex adequate failure topology.

sources.name: 07_privacy_data_protection_engineering_v2.md
sources.applicability: Purpose-bound derived surfaces, minimized typed attributes, authorization before aggregation/export, correction/deletion and restore-safe suppression; implementation evidence remains pending.

sources.name: 09_performance_scalability_resource_cost_engineering_v2.md
sources.applicability: Define workload-specific end-to-end success, latency, capacity and economic contracts; separate offered load, useful throughput, concurrency, utilization and saturation. Bound analytical work, queues and retries; preserve tenant access and privacy under load. Use representative reproducible correctness-checked measurements, explicit freshness-bearing cache semantics and governed useful-unit costs; no invented universal percentile, utilization, headroom or hosted performance claims.

sources.name: 12_data_database_storage_engineering_v2_golden_master.md
sources.applicability: PostgreSQL authority and tenant-aware keys/constraints, bounded transactions and concurrency evidence, stable resumable backfills, derived-store freshness and reconciliation, mixed-version migrations, and executed restore/deletion evidence. New engine or storage remains unjustified until measured need.

sources.name: 13_api_integration_distributed_systems_engineering_v2_golden_master.md
sources.applicability: Behavioral contracts include authority, time, unknown outcomes, repetition, ordering, consistency, bounded capacity, evolution and repair. Use native atomic identity and duplicate safety; timestamps are not causal versions, transport guarantees do not cover external effects. Require semantic runtime conformance, current access, controlled replay and authoritative reconciliation; provider sandbox and API descriptions do not prove deployed behavior. Source protocol-version claims have been read, not independently reverified.

sources.name: 15_backend_services_engine_engineering_v2.md
sources.applicability: Keep native authoritative domain rules and transactional boundaries; stable work identity differs from execution attempts. Bound concurrency, retry, queue growth, scheduling catch-up and repair; require resource-side fencing when leases can expire. Preserve tenant authorization, resource fairness, async privacy lifecycle, mixed-version execution compatibility and crash-safe acknowledgement. Local fixtures do not establish hosted operating readiness.

sources.name: master_playbook_standard_v2.0.md
sources.applicability: Risk-proportionate controls; requirements-to-tests traceability; separate evidence certainty, recommendation, implementation and real outcomes; no invented independent assurance or permission from reference documents.

sources.name: ui_master_playbook_v2.md
sources.applicability: Coherent appearance, semantics, state and behavior; native controls and existing tokens; explicit scope, loading, empty, permission, failure and recovery states. Preserve keyboard focus and responsive task capability; distinguish proposals, execution and evidence; truthful progress and risk-proportionate oversight. Automated checks alone do not establish accessibility or task usability.

sources.name: universal_design_principles_master_playbook_v2.md
sources.applicability: Task-driven hierarchy, grouping, legibility, semantic tokens and controlled density; accessible contrast and non-color meaning. Honest quantitative encodings and axes; no decorative charts, universal aesthetic recipes or invented trust cues. Preference, attention, brand association and causal product outcomes remain distinct.

sources.name: universal_software_ai_engineering_master_playbook_v2.md
sources.applicability: Explicit native state, authority and invariants; bounded work and failure semantics; independent verification matched to risk; privacy and lifecycle ownership; minimal adequate complexity; local evidence is not hosted or independent acceptance.

sources.name: ux_master_playbook_v2_double_validated_2026-09-21.md
sources.applicability: Prioritize the user outcome and whole journey, preserve existing mental models and valid work under failure. Explicit scope, evidence, recoverability, permission and partial completion; accessible native flows and responsive task parity. Assignment and telemetry integrity precede experiment conclusions; subjective preference and explanations do not establish objective usability or correctness.

sources.name: web_frontend_engineering_master_playbook_v2.md
sources.applicability: Use existing native web semantics and component contracts, with trusted server authorization, explicit state/cache ownership and stale-response protection. Preserve URL/history/focus and user input; no sensitive URL or browser persistence. Browser runtime, keyboard, zoom and assistive evidence remain separate from TypeScript/build/token checks.
